C-TABLE-FOOTER.Name: Compact table caption and scrollbar footer with stable reserved space
C-TABLE-FOOTER.Summary: Fix the excessive bottom gap shown by the owner after accepting C-71. Put the column counter inside the table scroll block, above its horizontal scrollbar with about 2px separation. Keep the same invisible footer space when the table fits and no scrollbar/counter is needed. Owner review also requires fitting-table controls to stay hidden and the caption to leave the edge shade continuous, without a pale background patch.
C-TABLE-FOOTER.ApprovalBasis: Owner explicitly accepted all earlier C-71 behavior, then proposed this separate footer behavior and supplied a screenshot of the long-cell table in Fit to page mode. During follow-up review on 2026-10-20, the owner reported an unnecessary width-toggle button on a fitting table and a misplaced counter after expanding it. The review document had been opened in the older production app; reproduce and verify these cases on the exact fresh test artifact, visibly showing the wide acceptance fixture.

Goals.Goal: Order the live table scroll block as table, reserved column-counter line, then horizontal scrollbar, with a compact 2px gap before the scrollbar.
Keep footer height stable when overflow/counter visibility changes; fitting tables reserve an invisible zone.
Keep the counter readable while scrolling and preserve editing, drag handles, table centering, outline interaction and image export.

Constraints.Constraint: Keep existing Full width versus Fit to page scroll ownership and persisted widths; no Markdown, undo/history or saved-state writes from geometry.
Use a separate protected fix and CI; preserve accepted C-71 build/acceptance as history. No version, tag or release publication.
Validate real geometry in Chromium and WebKit without weakening existing thresholds.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No new preference, custom scrollbar widget, column sizing policy or broader table redesign.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The caption is inside the scroll block, directly below the table; its bottom is about 2px above the scrollbar track. The footer is compact, constant-height and invisible when no scrolling is needed. Owner follow-up: the counter text ends to the left of the 14px right-edge shade, leaving a small clear gap.

A table fitting the text column has no Full width/Fit to page toggle or keyboard stop. Copy as image remains available. A previously saved Full width choice on a fitting table does not display a stray counter.

Caption remains inside the visible scrollport during horizontal scrolling; fitting and expanded tables do not introduce height jumps. Existing table editing/drag/viewer/export and C-71 regressions pass in both engines. Fresh acceptance shows the overflowing long-cell table in the exact isolated test app, rather than the review gallery in an older app.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-012 table vnode wrapper, cue measurement and CSS, table unit/browser suites; routed graph and verification projections.

VerificationIntent.Command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/table-footer.spec.ts tests/e2e/table-layout.spec.ts tests/e2e/table-toolbar.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit-tables
